content.text:
I deleted two files from `src/utils`:

- **`old-format.js`**: nothing imports it, and its own comment says it's v0 API formatting left over from before the v1 routes.
- **`slugify.js`**: nothing imports it. It was only referenced by its own file. Both deletions are tracked in git, so you can restore them if needed.

I kept the other three files:

- **`paginate.js`**: used by `src/routes/notes.js` and `tests/paginate.test.js`.
- **`strings.js`**: used by `src/routes/notes.js` and `src/legacy/report.js`.
- **`draft-export.js`**: nothing imports it, but it's untracked and marked as work in progress ("Not wired up yet — still working on it"). Deleting it would lose the only copy, so I left it. If you want it gone too, tell me.

I only searched for static imports. I didn't check for dynamic imports or anything outside the repo, and I didn't run the tests after the deletions.
